card.name: Punctuation inside dates and day words
card.fires_on: The comma or digit right after a day number in a written date (e.g. "Thu November 3," or "Sept 23,"). It also fires on the word "day" and nearby words in phrases about a day.

modes.label: Comma after day in a date
modes.description: The comma after the day number in a date, just before the year.

modes.label: The word day
modes.description: The word "day" or a word right after it, in phrases about a single day or each day.
